fields.description: Capeside Marina Residences is a marina-front collection of one- to three-bedroom apartments and duplexes on Sobha Siniya Island. The layouts include both compact homes and larger residences with service rooms and outdoor space. Marina, park and sea outlooks vary by tower position, with the developer’s own drawings identifying the relevant unit and floor.

research.community: Capeside Marina Residences · Sobha Siniya Island
overview: The Type A three-bedroom apartment combines a maid’s room and powder room with a large balcony. Other types use yards or different balcony arrangements. The total saleable area is not the enclosed suite area, and it should not be used as a substitute for the exact registered plan.
research.locationNote: Sobha Siniya Island, Umm Al Quwain, is established by the own developer page. Shared island facilities, access and opening arrangements require confirmation.
research.priceNote: The dedicated developer FAQ describes prices from around AED 1.98 million. Property Finder also preserves AED 1.98 million as its launch reference. Both are published guides; no selected unit quotation or available allocation has been verified.
research.paymentNote: The developer FAQ describes a 60/40 plan but does not break out a booking deposit or dated calendar. Property Finder gives 20% at launch, 40% construction and 40% handover. The displayed stages are that attributed portal breakdown, not a signed current unit schedule.
research.handoverNote: The own brochure prints ACD June 2030 on the floor-and-unit-plans section. Property Finder independently reports June 2030. This is anticipated completion, subject to the buyer’s contract.
